representations.name: distinguished deletion positivity component
representations.new_information: Retains negative-coordinate component membership discarded by orthant tests.
representations.first_test: Exact W4 spoke/rim orbit component slices.

representations.name: resultant and subresultant root ordering
representations.new_information: Controls root ordering and prevents unseen boundary crossings.
representations.first_test: Reconstruct the audited W4 spoke two-variable resultant and attempt the rim slice.

representations.name: semialgebraic bad-locus decomposition
representations.new_information: Can give a complete component counterexample search rather than sampling.
representations.first_test: Four-variable W4 stabilizer polynomial with an explicit path-to-orthant predicate.

representations.name: Garding-component barrier flow
representations.new_information: Provides canonical paths and may reduce domination to boundary signs.
representations.first_test: Check whether xi_e is monotone along positive rays and barrier trajectories on W4.

representations.name: component-relative SOS certificate
representations.new_information: Allows negative coefficients while certifying the complete channel.
representations.first_test: Use W4 boundary identities (S) and (R) to search a low-degree exact certificate.

representations.name: minimal-counterexample minor tree
representations.new_information: Explains when a 3-connected host search is closure-complete.
representations.first_test: Prove every non-3-connected minimal obstruction decomposes into already C-Gårding minors.

representations.name: minor-adaptive edge score
representations.new_information: Implements the existential edge in Fang-Ma Proposition 13.9.
representations.first_test: Compare spoke and rim scores on W4 and all edge orbits of K5.

representations.name: cycle-cocircuit endpoint sign vectors
representations.new_information: Retains which complement monomials form xi_e instead of only aggregate coefficients.
representations.first_test: Derive W4 xi_e from endpoint-connection sign vectors and test circuit elimination.

representations.name: Sturm fibration over a base component
representations.new_information: Turns multivariate domination into a recursive root-order problem.
representations.first_test: Fiber the W4 four-variable problem first in b, then over the proved (a,c) slice.

representations.name: joint rooted-determinant lift
representations.new_information: May provide a PSD observable on the correct unrooted component without scalar root multiplicities.
representations.first_test: Check same-component-count multiplicity obstruction on W4 before any general claim.

representations.name: zero-locus component separator
representations.new_information: Avoids full component parametrization by proving the xi-zero locus lies in the wrong sign chamber of the deletion polynomial.
representations.first_test: Use the K3,3 two-orbit pseudo-remainder to separate G=0 from y>1,F>0.
